简介:
An actress, writer, and host of cult favorite cultural and political podcast Red Scare, Dasha Nekrasova is known for her incisive, usually humorous critique of the media and the world we live in. She co-wrote and starred in the independent drama Wobble Palace, directed by Eugene Kotlyarenko…
Dasha Nekrasova (born 19 February 1991) is a Belarusian-American actress, writer and co-host of the podcast Red Scare. In 2018, she became known as "Sailor Socialism" after her interview with an InfoWars reporter went viral.
